import json, subprocess, sys, time
BASE = json.load(open("examples/input.json"))
def run(b):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"], input=b, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()[:120]
# nested duplicate keys
s = json.dumps(BASE)
s2 = s.replace('{"time": 0,', '{"time": 0, "time": 0,', 1)
print("nested dup:", run(s2.encode()))
# -0 for a number
s3 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": -0', 1)
print("-0:", run(s3.encode()))
# huge int
s4 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": 100000000000000000000000000000000', 1)
print("huge int:", run(s4.encode()))
# exponent float
s5 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": 0e0', 1)
print("0e0:", run(s5.encode()))
# unicode escape id
s6 = json.dumps(BASE).replace('"id": "a"', '"id": "\\u0061"')
print("unicode escape id:", run(s6.encode()))
# newline escape in id
s7 = s6.replace('"id": "\\u0061"', '"id": "a\\n"')
print("newline id:", run(s7.encode()))
# NaN literal
s8 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": NaN', 1)
print("NaN:", run(s8.encode()))
# Infinity
s9 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": Infinity', 1)
print("Inf:", run(s9.encode()))
# true where int
s10 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": true', 1)
print("true:", run(s10.encode()))
# null
s11 = s.replace('"time": 0', '"time": null', 1)
print("null:", run(s11.encode()))
# 16 MiB whitespace timing
big = b" " * (16*1024*1024 - len(s)) + s.encode()
t=time.time(); print("16MiB ws:", run(big), "time %.2f" % (time.time()-t))
# nested arrays deep-ish in a valid field (extra nesting = shape error)
s12 = s.replace('"length": 0', '"length": [0]', 1)
print("array for int:", run(s12.encode()))
# object for int
s13 = s.replace('"length": 0', '"length": {"a":1}', 1)
print("obj for int:", run(s13.encode()))
